comment: Every check the repository runs from make test or make test-heavy, once: tools/test/test-split-check.mjs holds the Makefile, the plugin Makefile template and the CI workflow to it. make test is the fast set the package %check runs: test.prerequisites are the prerequisites of test-checks, which make test runs with -k, then every plugin's test, then test.steps, each whatever the others answered. make test-heavy is the set that loads the built plugins into a host, run on every pull request in its own CI jobs. A check moves from one list to the other; it never leaves both. A Makefile target that runs a tools/test/ script and is in neither set is under elsewhere, with where it runs.

elsewhere.check-params-doc: ci.yml's make test job, beside gen --check
elsewhere.selftest: ci.yml's selftest job (about 80 minutes), when tools/ci-scope.sh says the change can move it
elsewhere.strip-crosscheck: by hand: needs the git history and the old commit's omx-contract and omx-dsp releases
elsewhere.strip-bands-bench: by hand: a CPU measurement, not a check
